description: Transcription (instantiation, AGENTS.md invariant 16): the proof instantiates STMT-COGITO-BORNE-THOUGHT-IS-OPINING and STMT-OPINION-IS-A-MOTION at the bearer that the reused Cogito subject theorem supplies.
